title: SECTOR THUMBNAIL NAMES CLEAR THE RINGS
why: Seen on the 4K lift screenshot of 2026-10-08: on the sector thumbnails a zone name could be printed straight through a cyan extraction ring (THE LONG DOCK on Cold Storage, BLAST LINE on The Cold Mile). A name that would touch a ring now moves to the nearest clear place just above or below it, inside its own zone.
now: On the lift page maps, zone names no longer run through the extraction rings.
